title: Book Three · Chapter 179: The Space by the Window
story:
By the end of October, Mum has finished all four sewing classes.

Her jacket has a new side piece now. She puts it near the window and studies the sleeve in the afternoon light.

Ronan's school pages cover part of the table.

“Could I use this space for two hours?” she asks.

He looks at the long pattern beside her hand.

“I can read in the yard.”

He gathers his book and loose pages. Mum spreads the pattern flat and moves her work box closer.

Ronan stops beside the shelf. She is using the bright part of the table now. He can picture her there during an ordinary morning after he leaves.

“You could use it like this later too,” he says.

Mum looks up.

“I would like the light. My smaller pieces can stay near the chair.”

He nods and puts his school pages on the shelf.

“I still want somewhere for these.”

“There is room.”

She points to the space beside his own books. Ronan puts the papers there and takes the phrase book outside.

For a while, he reads under the yard wall. Through the open door, he hears Mum move her scissors and smooth the cloth.

When Dad comes home, she puts the unfinished jacket on. One side is ready. She holds the other in place.

Dad looks carefully.

“A jacket.”

Mum smiles. “You learned the word.”

“I learned to look at the sleeve.”

Ronan laughs. Mum turns toward the window so Dad can see the new shape.

Afterward, she takes it off and puts it beside the pattern. Ronan brings his book back to the table when she has finished.

At their October household review, Dad puts twelve yuan and Mum eight into the study envelope. Their one hundred and forty becomes one hundred and sixty.

Ronan's sixty-nine and twenty and a half remain separate. The saved total is now two hundred and forty-nine and a half.

He writes the three amounts on his sheet. Mum puts the household book away and leaves her own pattern beside the work box.

At dinner, she tells Dad about a woman from the class. The woman has made a very unusual pocket on her practice jacket.

“For a whole book?” Ronan asks.

“Perhaps a very small one.”

Mum shows the pocket size with one hand.

“She tried it with a book from her bag.”

“Did it fit?” Dad asks.

“Only until she sat down.”

Ronan laughs. Mum moves her chair a little nearer the table.

“The paper looked right,” she says. “Then she wanted room for her hand too.”

“Like your bag strap.”

“Yes. You still have to try the thing.”

She tells them about the woman at the next table. The woman liked very neat little pockets. Mum wanted a deeper one on her own jacket.

Both kept changing their lines during the lesson.

Ronan listens while she describes the two patterns. He knows Mum has spent years making other people's clothes fit. In that room, she could try something for herself beside other people doing the same.

Dad asks about the new side piece again. Mum points to her pattern near the shelf, then returns to her food.

He lifts his phrase book from the chair. Mum laughs and shakes her head. Dad moves the food toward him, and Ronan puts the book safely on the shelf before he sits down.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

spread flat＝平铺开；smooth＝抚平；unusual＝不寻常的；household review＝核对家用开支。

## 理解问题

1. Mum是否完成了四次课？她怎样开始使用新的工作空间，又为Ronan保留什么？
2. 十月底父母实际存钱后，他们持有和三份合计各是多少？

## 读句子

**Mum spreads the pattern flat and moves her work box closer.**

拆开看：Mum / spreads the pattern flat / and moves her work box / closer.

Mum／把纸样铺平／并把自己的工作盒移到／更近的位置。
